basic_details.job_title: CSB CSGRC Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: The CSB - Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC), Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, will hold a walk-in interview at 10.00 AM on 3 December 2026 for one Junior Research Fellow (JRF). content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify an application fee.

content_sections.heading: About the Centre and the Project
content_sections.text: The CSB - Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC) is a centre of the Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, at P.B. No.44, Thally Road, Hosur - 635 109, Krishnagiri Dist., Tamil Nadu. The JRF will work on project PIE06015SIC, "Development and Validation of Species Specific in vitro Regeneration and Cryopreservation Protocols for Long-term Conservation of Mulberry (Morus sp.) Germplasm", funded by the Central Silk Board (CSB), Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India. The project runs from August 2026 to July 2029 (3 years).

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: One post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) is to be filled. The place of posting is the Mulberry Division, CSGRC-Hosur, Tamil Nadu-635 109. Desirable: candidates with the following will be preferred: Specialization in Biotechnology/Botany/Molecular Biology/Plant Physiology/Biochemistry/Genetics and Plant Breeding/Plant Genetic Resources/Plant Science Working experience in Plant Tissue Culture, Cryopreservation and Molecular Analysis Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the post. The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification (the notice is dated 19.11.2026). HRA is paid in addition to the amounts above. The notice does not mention any other allowance. The position is purely temporary, on a contractual basis, and co-terminus with the project, which runs from August 2026 to July 2029 (3 years). The recruitment procedures will be followed as per the Guidelines for Research Fellow (JRF/SRF/RA) hiring under CSB-coded R&D projects.

rows.qualification_required: Essential: M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: At the time of interview, candidates must bring the following documents with two sets of self-attested photocopies: One recent passport size photograph Certificates and mark sheets for all education qualifications (SSLC, PUC/HSC, B.Sc., M.Sc., etc.) Proof of date of birth No Objection Certificate (NOC) from the present employer, if applicable Certificates/documents related to research experience (if any) Copies of research experience, trainings, publications (if any) Community certificate (for SC/ST/OBC candidates, if applicable) Valid email ID and telephone/mobile number No prior application is required; eligible candidates may appear directly at the venue on the given date and time.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview. Canvassing in any form will lead to the cancellation of candidature. The decision of the Director-CSGRC shall be final and binding in all respects. For queries, the centre lists phone numbers 04344-222013 and 221148, fax 04344-220520, and e-mail [email protected] and [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. When is the CSB-CSGRC JRF walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Junior Research Fellow (JRF) post is at 10.00 AM on 3 December 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Where is the CSGRC JRF walk-in interview held?
faq.answer: It is held at the Auditorium, Main Office Building, CSB-Central Sericultural Germplasm Resources Centre (CSGRC), Central Silk Board, Ministry of Textiles, Govt. of India, Hosur - Thally Rd, Hosur, Tamil Nadu 635109.

faq.question: Q3. How many vacancies are there?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy for Junior Research Fellow (JRF), posted in the Mulberry Division, CSGRC-Hosur.

faq.question: Q4. What qualification is required for the CSGRC JRF post?
faq.answer: Candidates need an M.Sc. in any branch of Life Science/Agricultural Science from a UGC recognised university with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST candidates).

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for the CSGRC JRF post?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 35 years as on the date of notification, with a relaxation of 5 years for SC/ST/OBC, Women and Physically Challenged candidates.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the CSGRC JRF?
faq.answer: Candidates with NET/GATE get Rs. 31,000 + HRA for the first two years and Rs. 35,000 + HRA for the third year; those without NET/GATE get Rs. 21,000 + HRA and Rs. 25,000 + HRA respectively.

faq.question: Q7. Is HRA paid on top of the JRF pay?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice states HRA in addition to the fellowship amount in every year, for candidates both with and without NET/GATE.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I bring to the walk-in?
faq.answer: Bring a passport size photograph, education certificates and mark sheets, proof of date of birth, NOC if applicable, research experience documents if any, and community certificate if applicable, with two sets of self-attested photocopies, plus a valid email ID and mobile number.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CSGRC JRF a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the position is purely temporary, on a contractual basis and co-terminus with the project running from August 2026 to July 2029 (3 years).

faq.question: Q10. Will TA or DA be paid for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No, the notice states that no TA or DA will be provided to attend the interview.
